description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling FeaturePropertyDeleted events within the Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and implements logic to remove a feature property from a ThingBuilder when such an event occurs.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements an event handling strategy for FeaturePropertyDeleted events to modify a ThingBuilder accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to remove a feature property from the provided ThingBuilder based on the details in the FeaturePropertyDeleted event.
